x: At 15 miles Norris, running splendidly, was 2mins clear of Llewellyn who in turn was 1¼mins ahead of Pawsey(Mitcham) and Towl (HHH). Linstead was maintaining his pace well and had advanced to sixth, a further 1¾mins back.

Towl (HHH) was a comfortable winner in 29:53, with Shippen (31:30), Miller (31:35) and Masters (31:40), 3rd, 4th, 5th, Charlie Dabbs (34:40) could not overcome the going and finished an uncharacteristic 15th.
